# LaplandNightlife

> The honest guide to Finnish Lapland nightlife. 14 cities, 50+ verified nightclubs, aurora bars, live music and 2026 Oulu European Capital of Culture events.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://laplandnightlife.com/): Bars and nightclubs in Finnish Lapland
- [Cities](https://laplandnightlife.com/cities): Nightlife by city
- [Nightclubs](https://laplandnightlife.com/nightclubs): Nightclubs in Lapland
- [Aurora Bars](https://laplandnightlife.com/aurora-bars): Northern lights with a drink
- [Events](https://laplandnightlife.com/events): Nightlife events and festivals
- [Photography](https://laplandnightlife.com/photography): Night photography in Lapland
- [Summer Nights](https://laplandnightlife.com/summer-nights): Midnight sun summer nights
- [Tips](https://laplandnightlife.com/tips): Going out in Lapland — tips and etiquette

## Languages

English (default, no prefix), Finnish (/fi/), Swedish (/sv/), German (/de/), French (/fr/), Spanish (/es/), Italian (/it/), Dutch (/nl/), Brazilian Portuguese (/br/), Japanese (/ja/), Korean (/kr/), Simplified Chinese (/cn/)
